title: Connect App Store (one confirmation)
summary: The one confirmation behind first-run's Connect App Store: it names the key Polaris Key already has (Example Audio team key) and the app it found (DJDL for macOS, com.example.djdl), and says what turns on: DJDL's App Store channel and storefront together, store notifications set up and tested, and that nothing sells until an offer has an App Store SKU.
compare: Opened from first-run's Connect App Store (commerce.first-run) or the App Store row; the first-run page stays behind the scrim.
An L1 confirm with a neutral title (a routine, reversible step, EXPERIENCE.md §7): 'Connect the App Store for DJDL?'. Focus starts on Cancel.
What it uses is shown as facts, never fields: the key with where it lives and when it was last checked, and the app with its bundle id and Apple ID. Nothing to type (A-33).

Three consequences: the App Store channel and storefront turn on together (builds go to TestFlight; purchases add to licenses: one bullet each); store notifications are set up and checked with a test notification; nothing sells until an offer has an App Store SKU.

The button repeats the verb: 'Connect App Store' (primary, Commerce green). On success the dialog closes and the setup card ticks its first step (commerce.first-run-connected); no toast, because the card already shows the result.
An error stays inline in the dialog, says what went wrong and how to fix it, and the button becomes Try again (commerce.connect-app-store-error).
Phone: a bottom sheet (grab handle, rounded top, body scrolls within 90% of the screen), buttons full width and pinned, the primary on top; the facts stack label over value.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink; focus, hover, checked and selected take the accent of the service the element references (B17), never a status colour; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

Masthead mark (B4): from 1024px a 48px flat tile on this page (the feature's glyph on a landing page, the product's icon on a product page) replaces the orientation chip; below 1024 the chip carries the context; never on a dense data page, a record or a state page.

Dialog and drawer head (B4): a 3px rule in the origin's accent along the top (none on a destructive or cautious confirmation), a head band with a hairline, one leading glyph or none (severity on a confirmation, the subject's mark on a record, never a service tile), title at or under 20/28; blurred backdrop with a flat fallback under reduced transparency.

findings.issue: Bullets restate the title and the success state.
findings.resolution: Two bullets ('Builds go to TestFlight and purchases add to licenses.' and 'Nothing sells until an offer has an App Store SKU.'); Cancel is ghost; the page behind is the updated first-run.
